A.role: write when mutable OR frozen deterministic replay read only; Fine/DMA forbidden

B.role: frozen Fine measurement OR RAW DMA read; same-bank consumers mutually exclusive, different banks may operate concurrently
B.steady_state_target: 1 x 128-bit word per clk_mem when credit and downstream allow

pretrigger.tag: trigger carries onset_seq in signal sample time, not arrival write_ptr

window.write_guard: Do not write seq>=start_seq+depth while reserved
window.capacity_action: freeze last valid extent, markTRUNCATED/MAX_WINDOW; not valid replay
window.late_eop: validate history still belongs to this record; stop before wrap even before EOP arrives
window.b_read_alignment: physical word starts at start_ptr>>1; head_offset=start_ptr[0]; Fine consumes natural words with lane mask; DMA compacts only in dma_payload_packer

state_rules.ARMING: broadcast rolling input, establish fresh history
state_rules.ARMED: continue rolling writes; eligible for admission
state_rules.CAPTURE: continue writes but protect reserved start
state_rules.FROZEN_PENDING: last IQ stored; write disabled while late statistics align
state_rules.RELEASE: after last RAW consumer and no in-flight access, rearm; do not clear entire RAM

ownership.stale_or_duplicate_return: reject and increment counter; no decrements
ownership.default_RAW_release: record bytes accepted into reliable owned downstream storage AND all needed replay RAM reads completed; task/coeff refs may live longer
ownership.transmission_error: lost record event if RAW already released; retry-fromRAW requires longer retention policy

refs.analysis_ref: pins RAW while Fine job is pending/active; primary HIGH/MID/LOW all get a Fine disposition in normal mode
refs.upload_ref: pins RAW while selected/diagnostic RAW upload requires bank bytes
refs.replay_ref: pins RAW while A-port deterministic replay may still read the bank

ownership.release_rule: rearm only when analysis_ref=upload_ref=replay_ref=0 and all A/B in-flight RAM responses are quiescent
ownership.b_owner: per bank NONE/FINE/DMA; same bank mutually exclusive; different physical banks may serve Fine and DMA concurrently

reset: stop new A/B requests, drain or isolate in-flight RAM responses and downstream ownership, then increment owner_epoch/rearm; epoch alone does not stop readers
no_free_bank: DROP_NEW plus counters/event; FIR/ADC continuous; never overwrite frozen bank
bank_sizing: ceil(T_hold/PRI)+safety margin; hold includes rearm; pending replay and DMA share leases

quality.default: window OR and range stats required; optional8bit/sample sidecar

numbering: frame stream_group_id1..4; Python behavioral group_index0..3 maps +1
verification_scope: bank_model is behavioral, not real RAM pipeline or CDC model
primary_fine_policy: all three admitted primary range banks receive Fine jobs; unselected banks are not rearmed before Fine completes/cancels
